title: Operational Intelligence Proof Backlog
summary: Current public-safe evidence still needed to strengthen the Operational Intelligence doctrine, Ravikanth Seri's professional representation, and the seri.ai product proof loop.
principle: The site should publish claims only as far as the evidence supports them, and unresolved proof gaps should be visible to serious reviewers.

items.claim: Experienced operators and architects can understand where Operational Intelligence begins, where it ends, and how to challenge it.
items.evidenceNeeded: Structured reviews from SRE, architecture, AI engineering, governance, executive, and product reviewers using the practitioner review form.
items.currentEvidence: The Evidence Pack defines reviewer roles, dimension verdicts, evidence ledger fields, and doctrine impact categories.
items.nextProof: Collect at least five public-safe practitioner reviews that identify strongest claim, weakest claim, evidence needed, and implementation questions.
items.wouldChange: If reviewers cannot distinguish the model from observability, AIOps, ITIL, incident command, or chatbot-only assistance, revise the doctrine boundaries.

items.claim: The Operational Intelligence workflow improves reviewability compared with dashboard-only, chatbot-only, and ticket-only investigation modes.
items.evidenceNeeded: Same-facts OI-ROOM-001 comparison runs scored on evidence completeness, contradiction handling, missing-evidence honesty, hypothesis quality, decision safety, replayability, and reviewer confidence.
items.currentEvidence: The OI-ROOM-001 control comparison article and Evidence Pack define modes, allowed inputs, primary risks, and worksheet dimensions.
items.nextProof: Run the control comparison with independent reviewers and publish dimension-level results with limitations instead of an aggregate quality score.
items.wouldChange: If the workflow adds structure without improving judgment, simplify the model or narrow claims to the cases where structure helps.

items.claim: Ask Ravikanth is a useful interface to Ravikanth Seri's verified public professional graph rather than a generic chatbot wrapper.
items.evidenceNeeded: Reviewer-labeled Ask sessions across professional profile, doctrine, architecture, evidence, routing, unknown questions, and public-safety boundaries.
items.currentEvidence: Deterministic Ask fixtures, rubric dimensions, citation expectations, refusal behavior, and local fallback behavior are validated in the build.
items.nextProof: Compare local fallback, vector retrieval, and model synthesis on the same safe prompt set using only category, latency, success, failure, and reviewer verdict metadata.
items.wouldChange: If Ask cannot cite relevant public sources or separate fact from inference under realistic questions, reduce answer scope and improve retrieval before expanding claims.

items.claim: seri.ai can operate as a stable public beta with useful fallbacks when optional AI or database services are unavailable.
items.evidenceNeeded: Deployment observations for uptime, build health, route availability, Ask latency, fallback rate, contact failure rate, and privacy-safe analytics events.
items.currentEvidence: Deployment validators, API timeout handling, local fallbacks, rate limiting, analytics contracts, rendered-route validation, and performance budgets are enforced locally.
items.nextProof: After Vercel beta deployment, review production logs and analytics using only privacy-safe metadata and publish limitations in the release report or scorecard.
items.wouldChange: If fallback rate, route errors, or latency make review unreliable, prioritize reliability fixes before deeper publication work.

items.claim: The site feels publication-grade on mobile, tablet, and desktop for first-time executives, engineers, recruiters, and founders.
items.evidenceNeeded: Durable screenshots and keyboard walkthrough notes for the homepage, Ask Ravikanth, Operations Room, Work, Background, Doctrine, Radar, and Evidence Pack at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.
items.currentEvidence: Source-level viewport contracts, accessibility validation, rendered-route checks, and performance budgets pass, but fresh screenshot-grade inspection is still incomplete.
items.nextProof: Capture browser screenshots from a reachable local or preview environment, inspect hierarchy and density, and convert any concrete failures into regression checks.
items.wouldChange: If the Operations Room or homepage still feels like a demo at realistic viewports, reduce visual noise and sharpen first-task clarity without changing the architecture.

items.claim: Ravikanth Seri remains unmistakably the author, engineer, and professional identity behind the Operational Intelligence body of work.
items.evidenceNeeded: Approved portrait or identity asset, verified profile links, resume provenance, public-code links, LinkedIn signal, and a first-viewport path from person to work to evidence.
items.currentEvidence: The homepage, Start Here, Work, Resume, Background, GitHub link, LinkedIn link, and production-delivery chain connect the person to the public body of work.
items.nextProof: Add an approved portrait or durable identity asset when available, then verify first-viewport rendering and public-safe attribution.
items.wouldChange: If visitors still experience the site as an anonymous product, rebalance homepage and navigation copy toward Ravikanth as author without turning it into self-promotion.
